name: 瑞因霍尔德·荫篱
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1524
who: Reinhold Shadehedge, a human commander of the lower-city guard of a fallen luminous capital, fifty-eight years old but looking about forty, the man who keeps the line between the last shelter and the dark: about 183 cm, straight-backed and broad-shouldered. Navy-blue hair combed back neat and flat. Ice-green eyes that measure distance before they look at a face. His right eyebrow is broken in two by an old scar where a stone hit him as a boy, the gap bare of hair (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us). Always with him: a man-tall brass lamp pole, his family's old boundary lamp hanging from its head, the butt worn blunt on the paving stones. No jewellery, no glasses. A curt, steady, stubborn air of a man who counts everything in paces and lamps.
face: FACE, as in the references: a firm, square man's face that looks about forty, NOT young: ice-green eyes under level navy-blue brows, the right brow split by a short pale scar with a bare gap in the hair (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us); faint lines at the eye corners and across the brow; a straight nose; a hard, closed mouth; clean-shaven. Skin shadows a cool, pale tone.
build: 183 cm, straight-backed and broad-shouldered: a solid chest, long strong arms, the stance of a man who has stood watch for forty years.
palette: navy blue and dulled steel, guard white, old brass, ice green
casual: His guard commander's dress in the ash years: a dulled, darkened steel half-breastplate over a long navy-blue wool gambeson coat that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a short guard cape with a white border hanging from both shoulders, dark wool trousers and worn boots, a plain broad leather belt. In his right hand he holds upright the man-tall brass lamp pole, the boundary lamp at its head lit with a small white-gold flame, the worn butt resting on the ground beside his foot. He stands squarely beside it, a level, measuring look.
private: Off watch, keeping the lamp company at night: the breastplate and cape off, a plain long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the collar laced, a heavy navy wool blanket thrown round his shoulders like a cloak, the belt and trousers and boots. He holds a tin cup of something hot in one hand and stands beside the upright brass lamp pole, a tired, watchful, quiet look.
battle: Drawing the line, in the full old harness of the fallen capital's lower-city guard: the darkened steel half-breastplate buckled tight over the long navy gambeson coat, its seams traced with bone-silver thread gone dull grey and one old luminous core set at the breastbone still shining a cold white; a matching steel gorget, darkened steel pauldrons and vambraces; the white-edged guard cape thrown back off the right shoulder. He grips the man-tall brass lamp pole in both hands and drives its butt down at an angle, the family boundary lamp at its head flaring a hard white, a short tongue of white flame licking from the pole's butt. Feet planted wide, a cold, immovable look, the mouth shut.
formal: At the guard hall on the day he took up the lamp pole from his father: a long navy-blue wool officer's coat that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the white-bordered guard cape pinned at both shoulders with plain brass clasps, a small brass lamp badge at the collar, the dulled breastplate polished as bright as it will go, white wool gloves. He holds the brass lamp pole upright at his side with the lamp lit. He stands at attention, a grave, unbending look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the ice-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, steady and unyielding, the mouth closed. Hard white-gold light from the boundary lamp at the top edge of the frame on one side, cold ash-grey dark on the other. Foreground blur: the brass lamp pole and a few links of an old iron chain. He wears the darkened half-breastplate and the white-edged guard cape.
battle_old: Drawing the line: the darkened half-breastplate buckled tight over the navy gambeson, steel vambraces, the white-edged guard cape thrown back off the right shoulder. He grips the man-tall brass lamp pole in both hands and drives its butt down at an angle, the boundary lamp at its head flaring a hard white, a short tongue of white flame licking from the pole's butt. Feet planted wide, a cold, immovable look, the mouth shut.
gear: 极境（约 LVL 96）｜中｜照常｜3档｜穹都下城卫队统领，极境定三档，一身成套的帝国卫队旧战装，骸银线暗了、胸口一枚曜核还亮，招牌是荫篱家那杆界灯，正合灰的年月头领的样子。

name: 基利安（判词司祭）
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1543
who: Kilian, a human verdict-priest of a reed-country sanctuary, fifty-six years old and looking about fifty, the man who carries the lamp that finds horns: about 160 cm, short and thin, a little stooped. Moss-green short hair, half of it gone white. His left eye is amber; his right eye is covered by a milky white film, burnt when the sanctuary's eternal light burst in front of him (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us). His fingertips are stained a yellow brass colour by thirty years of lamp oil. Always with him: a long hazel pole over his shoulder, a lamp hanging from its tip under an old brass shade from the sanctuary's eternal-light lamp. No jewellery, no glasses. A soft-spoken, careful, quietly certain air, as if afraid of startling the wick.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, lined face of a man of about fifty, NOT young: a clear amber left eye and a right eye clouded over with an even milky white film (his right, on the viewer's left when he faces us); thin moss-green brows touched with white; fine wrinkles at the eye corners, two lines beside the mouth and a lined brow; hollow cheeks; a narrow nose; a small, gentle closed mouth; clean-shaven. Skin shadows a cool, pale tone.
build: 160 cm, short and thin: narrow sloping shoulders, a slight stoop, thin wrists and long, oil-stained fingers.
palette: ash grey and faded white, moss green, old brass, lamp-oil amber
casual: His verdict-priest's dress in the ash years: a long ash-grey wool priest's robe that once carried silver thread, the thread now dull grey, the robe closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem cut short to the shin for walking; a narrow faded white sash; a small leather oil flask hanging from a cord at the belt; worn soft boots. Over his right shoulder he carries the long hazel pole, the lamp under its old brass shade hanging dark from the far end. A quiet, attentive look, the mouth closed.
private: In the sanctuary's back room filling lamps: the robe off, a plain long-sleeved grey wool tunic with the cuffs pushed up, an oil-spotted canvas apron, soft shoes. He holds the old brass lamp shade in his hands, wiping it with a cloth, a calm, absorbed look.
battle: He is no fighter: the ash-grey robe belted tight, a dark hooded travelling cloak over it with the hood down, worn boots, the oil flask at the belt. He holds the long hazel pole forward in both hands, the lamp under its old brass shade glowing a cold pale white at the far end, raised to light someone's face. A still, searching look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing a little stooped with the long hazel pole held forward in both hands, the lamp at its far end lit and raised to search a face; a still, searching look, the mouth closed.
formal: Reading the verdicts in the square on the count's behalf: a long ash-grey priest's robe to the ankles, closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale grey over-tabard with a single small flame-in-a-ring stitched in dull silver on the chest, the faded white sash, a folded sheet of verdicts in his left hand. The hazel pole with the brass-shaded lamp stands upright in his right hand. He stands as straight as his back allows, a mild, unshakeable look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the single amber eye looking straight at the viewer and the white-filmed eye beside it, a mild, certain look, the mouth closed. Warm brass lamplight from above on one side, cold grey dusk on the other. Foreground blur: the old brass lamp shade and a curl of lamp smoke. He wears the ash-grey priest's robe.
battle_old: He is no fighter: the ash-grey robe belted tight, a dark hooded travelling cloak over it with the hood down, worn boots, the oil flask at the belt. He holds the long hazel pole forward in both hands, the lamp under its old brass shade glowing a cold pale white at the far end, raised to light someone's face. A still, searching look, the mouth closed.
gear: 共鸣｜中｜不打仗（判词司祭）｜1档｜苇岸圣所的判词司祭，提照角灯照人的角，不拿兵器，第三格走 battle_pose（举灯照脸），照原句交回。
